ABM Knowledgeware is an IT services and software company focused on e-Governance since 1998, with over 1,500 municipal bodies across multiple Indian states using its e-Municipality solutions. Along with its subsidiary InstaSafe Technologies and US-based sub-subsidiary InstaSafe Inc., the company provides e-Governance solutions, cybersecurity, cloud-based technology applications and software services, supported by capabilities in SAP HANA, mobility, cloud, AI, ML, RPA, and blockchain.
